name: godot-gdscript
_note: Godot 4 project (GDScript) — NON-HTTP, verified headless through the same CLI/process engine, with no game-engine-specific support in the harness. 'loads' imports the project headless so every .gd is parsed; 'tests' runs the GUT suite. Requires godot on PATH and the GUT addon at addons/gut/. The engine itself is verified: a trivial Godot project certifies PASS, and a GDScript parse error surfaces SCRIPT ERROR cause-first.
